in_marathi.name: Samved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samved हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Samved is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sam-vedana’, which means 'acquired knowledge' or 'wisdom gained through experience'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Veda, who is the god of knowledge and wisdom.
